prompt.project_info: Create a full-body eveningwear portrait from behind with a controlled look-back over the shoulder against a deep navy background.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with long blonde hair looking back over her shoulder, fitted royal-blue velvet gown with thin straps and secure coverage, gold heart-shaped drop earrings and gold bracelet, elegant relaxed posture.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical shot from behind, face and shoulder turned toward camera, solid deep navy background, gown and hair texture as focal points.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic overhead light highlighting velvet and hair, controlled shadows, elegant cinematic mood.
prompt.technical_specs: High-end fashion photography, 8K detail, sharp focus, realistic velvet, hair, jewelry and skin, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Full-body vertical fashion portrait from behind of a clearly adult fictional woman with long blonde hair looking back over her shoulder, fitted royal-blue velvet evening gown with thin straps and secure coverage, gold heart-shaped drop earrings and gold bracelet, dramatic overhead light, solid deep navy background, sharp elegant cinematic detail, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed back or intimate areas, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, blur, low quality, watermark, logo, text
